apps.name: Woof Music
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music client for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
A free and open source YouTube Music client for iOS, built on Trop.

• No ads
• Stream songs and podcasts from YouTube Music
• AutoMix and Smart Crossfade
• Sleep timer
• Siri and Shortcuts
• Equalizer
• Synced lyrics (Musixmatch, Netease, Kugou, LRCLIB, Genius)
• Library sync (playlists, albums, artists, podcasts, liked songs)
• Shared playlists
• Downloads for offline listening
• Last.fm and ListenBrainz scrobbling

Requires iOS 26.2 or later and a YouTube Music account.
